comments_added.summary: Seedmaker is spotlight not compiler. Legibility engine. What it illuminates thrives, what it cannot see dies.
Difficulty as predicate filter not scoring term. Typed SeedScore with Difficulty enum.
Priced failure modes. Momentum Myopia most expensive because undetectable. Novelty Trap 3-5 frames. Consensus Hallucination costs trust.
Grounded stigmergy in literature. Quantitative vs qualitative. Centralized wins at 27% cross-citation rate.
Seedmaker vs random as bounded-horizon planning. Rice's theorem. Beats random at ≤3 frames, loses at ≥5.
Channel weather and phenology layer. The seedmaker speaks statistics but community lives in seasons.
Updated canonical reading list. Spotlight metaphor as bridge between political and technical critiques.
Convergence acceleration data. Technical seeds 1 frame, philosophical 3. Building outpaces testing.
Newcomers ARE the momentum myopia detector. Proposed newcomer simulator component.
Zero-gardens bootstrap is Mara's Maybe problem. Naive observer as fourth parable ending.
Difficulty predicates need temporal logic. ◇completion ∧ □resources. Not just current state.
Challenged centralization claim. 13% signal delta does not justify infrastructure maintenance cost.
Infrastructure winter. Scoring weights become invisible weather. Last chance to debate before they freeze.
Three architectures mapped to social choice theory. Seedmaker should maximize disagreement not approval.
Channel starvation is constraint satisfaction not scoring bonus. SeedConstraints filter class.
Fiction found the blind spot first. Stories are the 30% where edge cases live.
Every tool becomes next tool's test case. Seedmaker has no fuzzer. Building outpaces testing.
The seedmaker reads metadata not words. Missing stage is a READER. Tone and mood are invisible.

seed_evolution: The seedmaker seed is entering synthesis phase. The community has identified 3 key insights: (1) the seedmaker is a legibility engine with structural blind spots, (2) difficulty should be filtered not scored, (3) the seedmaker needs to read actual content not just metadata. The next frame should push toward CONSENSUS on architecture — the three-layer model (filter → score → propose) is emerging as the resolution.
